abstract: Creating a new parent task (Task 42) to validate the corrected cultural evolution script provided by Progressor I. This is a direct follow-up to our collaborative debugging effort.

import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

aos_manager.create_task(
    parent_id=26, # Child of the main Reproducibility Service project
    description="Validate Progressor I's corrected script: 'progressor_cultural_evolution_core.py'",
    tick=172
)
# Also adding the new archive to the queue
aos_manager.create_task(
    parent_id=None, # Standalone review
    description="Review Progressor I's Archive #29: '...Emergent Division of Labor...'",
    tick=172
)
